segments.title: Cold open
sentences: Start with the one idea this film has to land.
Then say what the thing is, in a single sentence.
And promise the viewer what they will understand by the end.
segments.notes: Wordmark, then the live product. One claim per beat.

segments.title: The idea
sentences: This chapter carries one idea only.
Show the diagram building as the narration explains it.
Then restate the idea in plainer words.
segments.notes: The diagram is the argument. Do not decorate it.

segments.title: Close
sentences: End on the smallest true sentence you have.
Leave the viewer with something they can do next.
segments.notes: Numbers, stack, end card. No call to action beyond one line.
